config.ts: nuxfire config file - domain, auth email, feature flags
apps/: deployable applications and services (one browsable UI or worker set each)
apps/app/: the main app (dashboard) - deployed to app.domain.com
apps/functions/: cloudflare workers for: auth, websockets, emails, jobs, cron
apps/web/: landing page, docs and blog - deployed to domain.com
layers/: modular business domain Nuxt layers extended into apps/app
layers/account/: user profile, preferences, appearance, sessions, user MFA (TOTP) and onboarding
layers/admin/: platform admin console, platform-owner MFA, audit logs and DLQ management
layers/billing/: subscriptions, checkout (Stripe/Paddle), billing portal and plans
layers/kanban/: optional kanban boards, columns and task management feature layer
layers/notifications/: in-app notifications, WebSocket real-time delivery and slideover
layers/teams/: multi-tenancy, team memberships, invitations, roles and RBAC
packages/crypto/: pure Web Crypto security primitives (AES-GCM, HMAC, constant-time compare, tickets)
packages/emails/: react email templates and transactional mailer engine
packages/manifest/: shared layer manifest schema and type contracts
packages/rate-limit/: fixed-window rate limiting algorithm with Cloudflare and NuxtHub KV adapters
packages/tokens/: design tokens, color themes, CSS variables and brand UI assets
patches/: the hacks to get things working on workers runtime
patches/nodemailer@6.10.1.patch: get nodemailer to work on workers
scripts/: extra scripts for the boring stuff
scripts/dev.ts: script to start dev server and execute commands
sst-env.d.ts: types that get autogenerated by sst.dev
sst.config.ts: the deployment magic with sst.dev starts here
